privileged_info_for_vlm: The HBB genomic fragment is 1608 bp. The provided exon annotations are 51..142, 273..495, and 1346..1474. Therefore, Intron 1 must be coordinates 143..272 (Length: 130 bp) and Intron 2 must be 496..1345 (Length: 850 bp). GC content for Intron 1 is approximately 48.5% and Intron 2 is approximately 37.1%. The agent must use the UGENE GUI for the annotations and exports.
